newsitem.title: USA: Investment Grade Municipal Q4 shr flat.
newsitem.headline: Investment Grade Municipal Q4 shr flat.

text.p: Investment Grade Municipal Income Fund Inc said Friday that net investment income after preferred dividends for the fourth quarter ended September 30, 1996 was $2,418,219, or $0.23 a share, with total net realized and unrealized gains of $3,484,349, or $0.34 a share. its performance for the fourth quarter ended Sept. 30, 1996.
This compares to net investment income of $2,376,779, or $0.23 a share and net realized and unrealized gains of $1,985,342, or $0.19 a share for the previous fourth quarter.
For the fiscal year, the Fund's earnings from net investment income were $9,716,003, equal to $0.93 a share.
Total net realized and unrealized gains for the year were $3,503,278, or $0.35 a share.
This compares to net investment income of $9,076,866, or $0.88 a share and net realized and unrealized gains of $10,745,805, or $1.03 a share for the fiscal year ended September 30, 1995.
